pairs.target: " wēn shù , jiē shéng ! "
pairs.english: “Wen Shu, catch the rope!”
pairs.hanzi: “温述，接绳！”

pairs.target: lín zhào jiāng shéng tóu pāoxiàqù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao threw down the rope end.
pairs.hanzi: 林照将绳头抛下去。

pairs.target: wēn shù táishǒu jiē zhù , wǎng bì shàng rào le yídào , xiān ràng xǔ cén zhuā wěn .
pairs.english: Wen Shu caught it with a raised hand, wound it once around his arm, and first made sure Xu Cen had a firm grip.
pairs.hanzi: 温述抬手接住，往臂上绕了一道，先让许岑抓稳。

pairs.target: tā cǎi zhe shuǐxià de shítou nuó dào jiē qián , gāng bǎ jiǎo fàngshàngqù , zuì xià nà kuài shíjiē biàn wǎng wàifān le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: She edged over the submerged stones to the steps; the moment she planted her foot, the lowest slab tilted outward a little.
pairs.hanzi: 她踩着水下的石头挪到阶前，刚把脚放上去，最下那块石阶便往外翻了一点。

pairs.target: " bié cǎi biān ! "
pairs.english: “Not on the edge!”
pairs.hanzi: “别踩边！”

pairs.target: shào píng hǎn .
pairs.english: Shao Ping shouted.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平喊。

pairs.target: xǔ cén pānzhù shéng , tiēzhe jiē miànshàng lái .
pairs.english: Gripping the rope, Xu Cen climbed up close against the steps.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑攀住绳，贴着阶面上来。

pairs.target: lín zhào fú xiàshēn , jiē zhù tā shēnchū de shǒu , wǎnghòu zuò , yīlǐng bèi lè dé jǐnjǐn tiē zài hóutóu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao bent down, caught her outstretched hand and sat back, her collar pulled tight against her throat.
pairs.hanzi: 林照伏下身，接住她伸出的手，往后坐，衣领被勒得紧紧贴在喉头。

pairs.target: xǔ cén bàn guì dào zhuàn táishàng , zhǎngxīn cóng tā shǒulǐ chōuchūqù , lìkè zhuāzhù le shéng de lìng yíduàn .
pairs.english: Xu Cen reached the landing on one knee, pulled her hand free of Lin Zhao's grip and immediately gripped another section of rope.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑半跪到转台上，掌心从她手里抽出去，立刻抓住了绳的另一段。

pairs.target: " xiàmiàn hái zài dòng . "
pairs.english: “It's still moving below,”
pairs.hanzi: “下面还在动。”

pairs.target: tā chuǎn zhe shuō , " yícì yígè . "
pairs.english: she said breathlessly. “One at a time.”
pairs.hanzi: 她喘着说，“一次一个。”

pairs.target: wēn shù méiyǒu gēnshàng .
pairs.english: Wen Shu didn't follow.
pairs.hanzi: 温述没有跟上。

pairs.target: tā jiāng shéng dì dào dùhéng shǒubiān , shěn yàn zhōu de jiàn yǐjīng cóng dùn páng tànchūqù .
pairs.english: He passed the rope within Du Heng's reach; Shen Yanzhou's sword had already slid out beside the shield.
pairs.hanzi: 他将绳递到杜衡手边，沈砚舟的剑已经从盾旁探出去。

pairs.target: yìngké zhuàng dé dùn yì wāi , dùhéng shùnzhe shéng wǎnghòu huàn jiǎo , cái méi huá xià shítou .
pairs.english: A blow from the hard shell tilted the shield; Du Heng shifted his foot back along the rope, just managing to stay on the stone.
pairs.hanzi: 硬壳撞得盾一歪，杜衡顺着绳往后换脚，才没滑下石头。

pairs.target: lín zhào zhǐxiàng yòubiān .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao pointed right.
pairs.hanzi: 林照指向右边。

pairs.target: " nàlǐ dǔzhù le .
pairs.english: “It's blocked there.
pairs.hanzi: “那里堵住了。

pairs.target: shuǐ chūbúqù ! "
pairs.english: The water can't get out!”
pairs.hanzi: 水出不去！”

pairs.target: shào píng cháo dī gǒng kàn .
pairs.english: Shao Ping looked toward the low arch.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平朝低拱看。

pairs.target: nà tuán kūzhī chàn le chàn , yìgēn xìtiáo bèi xījìn shíbǎn páng de zhǎi fèng , héng zhe kǎzhù , hòumiàn de báimò biàn gèng mì le .
pairs.english: The clump of dead branches trembled; a thin twig was sucked into the narrow gap beside the slab and jammed crosswise, thickening the white foam behind it.
pairs.hanzi: 那团枯枝颤了颤，一根细条被吸进石板旁的窄缝，横着卡住，后面的白沫便更密了。

pairs.target: " shí yán néng rào dào shàngtóu . "
pairs.english: “The ledge goes around to the top,”
pairs.hanzi: “石沿能绕到上头。”

pairs.target: lín zhàoshuō , " wǒ guòqù kàn . "
pairs.english: Lin Zhao said. “I will go and look.”
pairs.hanzi: 林照说，“我过去看。”

pairs.target: " xiān jì yāo . "
pairs.english: “Tie yourself in at the waist first.”
pairs.hanzi: “先系腰。”

pairs.target: shào píng chě chū bǎng bèi jià de chángshéng , ràoguò tā yāobèi , kòujǐn , yòu jiāng lìngyìtóu jì zài shí dūn shàng .
pairs.english: Shao Ping pulled out the long rope used to secure the pack frame, looped it around her waist and back, fastened it, then tied the other end to the stone pier.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平扯出绑背架的长绳，绕过她腰背，扣紧，又将另一头系在石墩上。

pairs.target: tā chě le chě jié , shǒu yǐjīng shēnxiàng huálún .
pairs.english: She tugged at the knot, her hand already reaching for the pulley.
pairs.hanzi: 她扯了扯结，手已经伸向滑轮。

pairs.target: " gōngzǐ !
pairs.english: “Young master!
pairs.hanzi: “公子！

pairs.target: wǒmen qù yòubiān kànkàn néng bunéng tōngshuǐ ! "
pairs.english: We are going right to see if we can open a way for the water!”
pairs.hanzi: 我们去右边看看能不能通水！”

alignment.english: open a way for the water

pairs.target: shào píng cháo xià hǎn .
pairs.english: Shao Ping called down.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平朝下喊。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu méiyǒu huítóu , zhī jiāng jiàn héng guòlái , bī kāi nàtiáo wánhǎo de qián tuǐ .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou didn't turn; he merely leveled his sword, forcing back the intact foreleg.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟没有回头，只将剑横过来，逼开那条完好的前腿。

pairs.target: " bié xiàshuǐ .
pairs.english: “Don't enter the water.
pairs.hanzi: “别下水。

pairs.target: zhànbúzhù jiù huílái ! "
pairs.english: Come back if you can't keep your footing!”
pairs.hanzi: 站不住就回来！”

pairs.target: xǔ cén jiē wěn le xiàmiàn de shéng , gěi tāmen ràngchū shí yán rùkǒu .
pairs.english: Xu Cen took a firm hold of the rope below and cleared the entrance to the ledge for them.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑接稳了下面的绳，给他们让出石沿入口。

pairs.target: lín zhào dàishàng huálún , tiěgōu hé yì jié shéngtào , shào píng jiāng lìng yífù diàosuǒ de yìtóu kòu zài shí dūn shàng , yú shéng jiāodào tā shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao took the pulley, iron hook and a short rope sling; Shao Ping clipped one end of the other hauling line to the stone pier and placed the remaining rope in her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 林照带上滑轮、铁钩和一截绳套，邵平将另一副吊索的一头扣在石墩上，余绳交到她手里。

pairs.target: shí yán búguò yìjiǎo duō kuān , yán qiáng huǎnhuǎn wǎng xià xié , kào nèi nà bànbiān hái gān zhe .
pairs.english: The ledge was only just over a foot wide, sloping gently downward along the wall, the inner half still dry.
pairs.hanzi: 石沿不过一脚多宽，沿墙缓缓往下斜，靠内那半边还干着。

pairs.target: tā cè guò shēn , jiǎodǐ yìdiǎndiǎn cāguòqù , xiān shì shí , zài nuó lìngyìzhī jiǎo .
pairs.english: She turned sideways and edged across little by little on the soles of her feet, testing the ground first, then shifting the other foot.
pairs.hanzi: 她侧过身，脚底一点点擦过去，先试实，再挪另一只脚。

alignment.english: on the soles of her feet

pairs.target: bèihòu gōngxiánxiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: A bowstring sounded once behind her.
pairs.hanzi: 背后弓弦响了一声。

pairs.target: tā huítóu yìpiē , duàn zhù páng nà zhī dài jiàn de xiǎoshòu fān qǐ bànjié shēnzi , yòu bèi yìzhī jiàn yā huíshuǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: She glanced back: the arrow-bearing small beast rose halfway beside the broken pillar, only to be driven back into the water by another arrow.
pairs.hanzi: 她回头一瞥，断柱旁那只带箭的小兽翻起半截身子，又被一支箭压回水里。

pairs.target: tā méi zài huítóu .
pairs.english: She didn't look back again.
pairs.hanzi: 她没再回头。

pairs.target: ràoguò qiángjiǎo , shuǐshēng dǒurán dà le .
pairs.english: Beyond the corner, the roar of water abruptly swelled.
pairs.hanzi: 绕过墙角，水声陡然大了。

pairs.target: dī gǒng jiù zài jiǎoxià , bànbiān cáng zài shí yán dǐxià .
pairs.english: The low arch was directly below her, half hidden beneath the ledge.
pairs.hanzi: 低拱就在脚下，半边藏在石沿底下。

pairs.target: xié bǎn de shàngduān dǐ zhe gǒng bì , xiàduān què qiào xiàng tíngyuàn ,
pairs.english: The slab's upper end rested against the arch wall, but its lower end tilted toward the courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 斜板的上端抵着拱壁，下端却翘向庭院，

pairs.target: yòujiǎo cáng zài gǒng bì bèihòu , bèi yíkuài wǎnkǒu dà de suìshí kǎzhù , zhītiáo quán guà zài bǎn shàng .
pairs.english: Its right corner was hidden behind the arch wall, jammed by a broken stone about the width of a bowl; all the branches hung on the slab.
pairs.hanzi: 右角藏在拱壁背后，被一块碗口大的碎石卡住，枝条全挂在板上。

pairs.target: shuǐ zhī cóng zuǒbiān jǐchū yìgǔ , wǎng hēi chù zuàn .
pairs.english: Water squeezed through only on the left, a single stream diving into the dark.
pairs.hanzi: 水只从左边挤出一股，往黑处钻。

pairs.target: nà kuài dàbǎn bùnéng yìngtuō .
pairs.english: The big slab couldn't simply be dragged.
pairs.hanzi: 那块大板不能硬拖。

pairs.target: tā jiàn guò yāzhù huò dài de zhòng xiāng , yuè zhuài , dàikǒu lè dé yuè sǐ .
pairs.english: She had seen how heavy crates pinned sacks of goods: the harder you pulled, the tighter the sacks' mouths cinched shut.
pairs.hanzi: 她见过压住货袋的重箱，越拽，袋口勒得越死。

pairs.target: lín zhào dūn dī , zhuāzhù qiángjiǎo tūchū de shí léng , jiāng yìzhī jiǎo wǎng huíshōu , gěi huálún shéng ràngkāi wèizhì .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao crouched, gripped a projecting stone ridge at the corner and drew one foot back, making room for the pulley rope.
pairs.hanzi: 林照蹲低，抓住墙角凸出的石棱，将一只脚往回收，给滑轮绳让开位置。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tiěgōu tàn xiàqù , dāzhù xiǎoshítou wàifān de jiǎo , huálún guà zài gōu wěi ;
pairs.english: She lowered the iron hook to catch the little stone's jutting corner and hung the pulley from the hook's tail;
pairs.hanzi: 她把铁钩探下去，搭住小石头外翻的角，滑轮挂在钩尾；

pairs.target: diàosuǒ cóng shí dūn qiān lái , ràoguò lún cáo , yòu zhéhuí shào píng shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: the hauling line ran from the pier, around the groove, then back to Shao Ping's hands.
pairs.hanzi: 吊索从石墩牵来，绕过轮槽，又折回邵平手里。

pairs.target: " xiān shōu yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: “Take up a little first.”
pairs.hanzi: “先收一点。”

pairs.target: liǎnggǔ shéng jiànjiàn bēngzhí .
pairs.english: The two strands slowly straightened under tension.
pairs.hanzi: 两股绳渐渐绷直。

pairs.target: xiǎoshítou huàng le huàng , shíbǎn biānyuán shènchū yídào huángshuǐ .
pairs.english: The little stone rocked, and a line of yellow water seeped out at the slab's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 小石头晃了晃，石板边缘渗出一道黄水。

pairs.target: tā xīnlǐ yí tiào .
pairs.english: Her heart leapt.
pairs.hanzi: 她心里一跳。

pairs.target: " zài ——"
pairs.english: “A little more—”

pairs.target: tiěgōu hūrán huátuō , cā zhe bǎnbiān tánshànglái .
pairs.english: The iron hook suddenly slipped, sprang up and grazed the slab's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 铁钩忽然滑脱，擦着板边弹上来。

pairs.target: tā běnnéng dì suōshǒu , gōu jiān cóng zhǐjié páng lüèguò , yāo shàng de shéng yě bèi tā chě jǐn le .
pairs.english: She instinctively snatched her hand back; the hook tip skimmed past her knuckles, and her movement pulled the waist rope tight too.
pairs.hanzi: 她本能地缩手，钩尖从指节旁掠过，腰上的绳也被她扯紧了。

pairs.target: " sōng ! "
pairs.english: “Slack!”

pairs.target: shào píng lìkè fàng huí yíduàn .
pairs.english: Shao Ping immediately paid out a length.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平立刻放回一段。

pairs.target: tā bèi tiēqiáng chuǎnqì , zhǎngxīn zài shī shí shàng cèng diào yìcéng pí , huǒlàlà dì téng .
pairs.english: She panted with her back against the wall; a layer of skin had been scraped from her palm on the wet stone, and it burned fiercely.
pairs.hanzi: 她背贴墙喘气，掌心在湿石上蹭掉一层皮，火辣辣地疼。

pairs.target: shuǐ pāi shàng xié biān .
pairs.english: Water slapped the edge of her shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 水拍上鞋边。

pairs.target: xiàmiàn yǒurén jiào le yìshēng dùhéng .
pairs.english: Someone below called Du Heng's name.
pairs.hanzi: 下面有人叫了一声杜衡。

pairs.target: tā kànbújiàn rén , zhī tīngjiàn dùn shàng nà yíxià mēndé lìhài , suíhòu shì wēn shù de shēngyīn : " zuǒjiǎo biélí ! "
pairs.english: She couldn't see anyone, only hear a terribly dull blow on the shield, followed by Wen Shu's voice: “Don't lift your left foot!”
pairs.hanzi: 她看不见人，只听见盾上那一下闷得厉害，随后是温述的声音：“左脚别离！”

pairs.target: tā jiāng shǒuzhǎng dǐ zài yī shàng , cādiào nián shuǐ .
pairs.english: She pressed her palm against her clothes and wiped away the clinging water.
pairs.hanzi: 她将手掌抵在衣上，擦掉黏水。

pairs.target: fāngcái nà diǎn shíjiǎo guàbúzhù , shéng dé cóng shí dǐ dōu guòqù .
pairs.english: That little stone corner wouldn't hold; the rope had to loop underneath the stone.
pairs.hanzi: 方才那点石角挂不住，绳得从石底兜过去。

pairs.target: " gěi wǒ héngmù ! "
pairs.english: “Give me the crossbar!”
pairs.hanzi: “给我横木！”

pairs.target: shào píng jiāng yífù bèi jià fàng píng , chōuchū héngmù , yánzhe shí yán dì lái .
pairs.english: Shao Ping laid a pack frame flat, pulled out its crossbar and passed it along the ledge.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平将一副背架放平，抽出横木，沿着石沿递来。

pairs.target: tā jiē zhù , yòng mùtou dǐngzhù xiǎoshítou wàicè , shì zhe wǎng pángbiān bō .
pairs.english: She took it, set the wood against the little stone's outer face and tried to nudge it sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 她接住，用木头顶住小石头外侧，试着往旁边拨。

pairs.target: shítou méiyǒu chūlái , dǐxià què zhāngkāi le bàn zhǐ kuān de fèng .
pairs.english: The stone didn't come out, but a gap half a finger wide opened underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 石头没有出来，底下却张开了半指宽的缝。

pairs.target: gòu chuān shéng le .
pairs.english: Now there was room to thread the sling.
pairs.hanzi: 够穿绳了。

pairs.target: tā jiāng shéngtào cóng mùtou páng sòngxiàqù , láihuí shì le liǎngcì , cái yòng gōu jiān cóng shí dǐ tiāochū lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: She fed the sling down beside the wood, tried twice to work it back and forth, then finally fished out the other side beneath the stone with the hook tip.
pairs.hanzi: 她将绳套从木头旁送下去，来回试了两次，才用钩尖从石底挑出另一边。

pairs.target: tiěgōu zhè huíkòu jìn shéngtào , búzài yǎo zhe nàge guānghuá de jiǎo .
pairs.english: This time the iron hook clipped into the sling instead of biting at that smooth corner.
pairs.hanzi: 铁钩这回扣进绳套，不再咬着那个光滑的角。

pairs.target: tā bǎ mùtou yādī , ràng shéng tiēzhù shítou dǐxià zuì zhǎi de nà yídào .
pairs.english: She pressed the wood down, keeping the rope against the narrowest part beneath the stone.
pairs.hanzi: 她把木头压低，让绳贴住石头底下最窄的那一道。

pairs.target: " shào shīfu , màn shōu .
pairs.english: “Master Shao, take up slowly.
pairs.hanzi: “邵师傅，慢收。

pairs.target: wǒ zhè tóu hái yā zhe . "
pairs.english: I am still holding it down here.”
pairs.hanzi: 我这头还压着。”

pairs.target: nà tóu méiyǒu lìkè lā .
pairs.english: There was no immediate pull from the other end.
pairs.hanzi: 那头没有立刻拉。

pairs.target: shào píng xiān jiāng mó zài shí léng shàng de shéng wǎng wài bōkāi , cái chén xiàshēn , shuāngshǒu jiāotì shōu shéng .
pairs.english: Shao Ping first eased the rope away from the sharp stone edge it was rubbing, then settled his weight and hauled hand over hand.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平先将磨在石棱上的绳往外拨开，才沉下身，双手交替收绳。

pairs.target: mù huálún zhī le yìshēng , gōu wěi yìdiǎndiǎn cháo shàng tái .
pairs.english: The wooden pulley gave a squeak, and the hook's tail rose little by little.
pairs.hanzi: 木滑轮吱了一声，钩尾一点点朝上抬。

pairs.target: xiǎoshítou zhuǎn le .
pairs.english: The little stone turned.
pairs.hanzi: 小石头转了。

pairs.target: lín zhào shǒulǐ de héngmù hūrán qīng le yì jié .
pairs.english: The crossbar in Lin Zhao's hands suddenly became noticeably lighter.
pairs.hanzi: 林照手里的横木忽然轻了一截。

pairs.target: tā xiǎnxiē shùnshì wǎngqián pū , yāo shéng què xiān chězhù le tā .
pairs.english: She almost pitched forward with it, but the waist rope caught her first.
pairs.hanzi: 她险些顺势往前扑，腰绳却先扯住了她。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn tái xī dǐ qiáng , sōngkāi mùtou , wǎng nèi suōhuí jiān .
pairs.english: She hurriedly raised a knee against the wall, let go of the wood and drew her shoulder back in.
pairs.hanzi: 她赶紧抬膝抵墙，松开木头，往内缩回肩。

pairs.target: suìshí cóng bǎn jiǎo tuō chūlái , diào zài shéngtào lǐ .
pairs.english: The broken stone came free of the slab's corner and hung in the sling.
pairs.hanzi: 碎石从板角脱出来，吊在绳套里。

pairs.target: nà kuài yìzhí bú dòng de xié bǎn xiānshì wǎngxiàchén , jiēzhe bèi tíngyuàn lǐ de shuǐ dǐng dé yì zhuǎn , kūzhī liántóng héngmù yìqí zuānjìn gǒng xià .
pairs.english: The immobile slab first sank, then turned under the pressure of the courtyard's water; branches and crossbar plunged together beneath the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 那块一直不动的斜板先是往下沉，接着被庭院里的水顶得一转，枯枝连同横木一齐钻进拱下。

pairs.target: shēngyīn quán biàn le .
pairs.english: The sound changed completely.
pairs.hanzi: 声音全变了。

pairs.target: fāngcái jiānxì de sī shēng biànchéng yídào húnhòu de hōngxiǎng , báimò měngdì cóng tā jiǎoxià chě guòqù .
pairs.english: The earlier thin hiss became a deep roar; white foam swept violently beneath her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 方才尖细的嘶声变成一道浑厚的轰响，白沫猛地从她脚下扯过去。

pairs.target: tā sǐsǐ zuàn zhù shí léng , yǎnjīng bèi shuǐhuā dǎ dé zhēngbùkāi , zhī jué jiǎodǐ yì kōng , xiégēn zài shí yán shàng huá guò xiǎobànjié .
pairs.english: She gripped the ridge tightly, her eyes battered shut by the spray; she felt her footing vanish, her heel sliding partway over the ledge.
pairs.hanzi: 她死死攥住石棱，眼睛被水花打得睁不开，只觉脚底一空，鞋跟在石沿上滑过小半截。

pairs.target: yāobèi yì jǐn , zǎoxiān jì hǎo de shéng bēngzhù le .
pairs.english: A sharp pull caught her waist and back; the rope tied earlier had held.
pairs.hanzi: 腰背一紧，早先系好的绳绷住了。

pairs.target: shào píng de shēngyīn gé zhe shuǐ xiǎng chuánlái : " jiǎo shōuhuí qù ! "
pairs.english: Shao Ping's voice came through the rush of water: “Pull your foot back!”
pairs.hanzi: 邵平的声音隔着水响传来：“脚收回去！”

pairs.target: tā zhōngyú jiāng jiǎo shōuhuí lái , tiēzhe qiáng zuò zhù .
pairs.english: She finally drew her foot back and sat against the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 她终于将脚收回来，贴着墙坐住。

pairs.target: ěr páng réng shì shuǐ .
pairs.english: The sound of water still filled her ears.
pairs.hanzi: 耳旁仍是水。

pairs.target: tā mǒ le liǎnghuí yǎn , cái kànjiàn yòubiān tíng jiǎo de kūzhī sàn le , shuǐwén yídàodào wǎng gǒng xià nǐng qù .
pairs.english: Only after wiping her eyes twice did she see that the dead branches in the right-hand corner had scattered, ripples twisting one after another beneath the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 她抹了两回眼，才看见右边庭角的枯枝散了，水纹一道道往拱下拧去。

pairs.target: zuǒ qiáng pòkǒu hái zài tǎng , tíngyuàn lǐ de shuǐ què méiyǒu lìkè tuì , dùhéng jiǎo biān réng fān zhe ní .
pairs.english: Water still poured from the breach on the left wall, but the water in the court didn't recede at once; mud still churned around Du Heng's feet.
pairs.hanzi: 左墙破口还在淌，庭院里的水却没有立刻退，杜衡脚边仍翻着泥。

pairs.target: " bié sōng xiàmiàn nàgēn ! "
pairs.english: “Don't let go of the rope below!”
pairs.hanzi: “别松下面那根！”

pairs.target: tā hǎn .
pairs.english: she shouted.
pairs.hanzi: 她喊。

pairs.target: tā cè guò liǎn , cóng qiángjiǎo wàng huíqù .
pairs.english: She turned her face and looked back around the corner.
pairs.hanzi: 她侧过脸，从墙角望回去。

pairs.target: xǔ cén zhèng chēng zhe shéng , tīngjiàn biàn cháo tā zhèbiān kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Xu Cen was bracing the rope; she heard the shout and glanced briefly toward Lin Zhao.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑正撑着绳，听见便朝她这边看了一眼。

pairs.target: wēn shù jiè shéng nuó jìn shíjiē , téngchū de wèizhì bèi dùhéng yì jiǎotà zhù .
pairs.english: Wen Shu used the rope to edge closer to the steps; the space he left was filled by Du Heng's foot.
pairs.hanzi: 温述借绳挪近石阶，腾出的位置被杜衡一脚踏住。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu gēnzhe tuì le bànbù , qī lán de gōng zhōngyú cóng yòucè zhuǎnguò lái , duì zhù zhuī jìn de yìngké .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou followed half a step back, and Qi Lan's bow finally swung from the right to face the approaching shell.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟跟着退了半步，戚岚的弓终于从右侧转过来，对住追近的硬壳。

pairs.target: lín zhào xiǎng zhàn qǐlái , tuǐ què bùtīngshǐhuàn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao tried to stand, but her legs wouldn't obey.
pairs.hanzi: 林照想站起来，腿却不听使唤。

pairs.target: tā zhǐhǎo jìxù zuò zhe , liǎngzhīshǒu jiá zài xī jiān , děng nà zhèn dǒu guòqù .
pairs.english: She could only stay seated, both hands held between her knees, waiting for the shaking to pass.
pairs.hanzi: 她只好继续坐着，两只手夹在膝间，等那阵抖过去。

pairs.target: yì jiéduàn zhī zài tíng zhōng dǎlegè xuán , mànmàn bèi tuō xiàng tā jiǎoxià .
pairs.english: A broken twig spun in the courtyard and was slowly drawn toward her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 一截断枝在庭中打了个旋，慢慢被拖向她脚下。

pairs.target: yuánxiān méi zài shuǐ lǐ de shí biān lùchū le yíxiàn , shuǐ tuì guò dùhéng de xītóu , yòu dī le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: A sliver of the once-submerged stone edge appeared; the water dropped past Du Heng's knees, then a little lower.
pairs.hanzi: 原先没在水里的石边露出了一线，水退过杜衡的膝头，又低了一点。

pairs.target: " zhànzhù le ! "
pairs.english: “I've got my footing!”
pairs.hanzi: “站住了！”

pairs.target: tā hǎn .
pairs.english: he shouted.
pairs.hanzi: 他喊。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn tā de hòujiǎo luò le xiàqù .
pairs.english: She saw his rear foot come down.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见他的后脚落了下去。

pairs.target: dùn wǎngqián yì chén , zhè yícì , méiyǒu zài wǎnghòu huá .
pairs.english: The shield dipped forward; this time, it didn't slide back again.
pairs.hanzi: 盾往前一沉，这一次，没有再往后滑。
